name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM): Farm Machinery Subsidy
summary: Subsidy for buying tractors, power tillers, seed drills, drones and other farm machinery, paid directly into your bank account.

benefits.headline: 40% to 50% subsidy on farm machinery
details: 50% of the machine cost for SC/ST farmers, small and marginal farmers and women; 40% for other farmers (subject to a ceiling for each machine type, set by the scheme).
Paid through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) after you buy the machine from an approved dealer.
Custom Hiring Centres run by FPOs, cooperatives and rural entrepreneurs also get support, so you can hire machines cheaply.

summary: Any farmer with agricultural land can apply, and small/marginal farmers, women and SC/ST farmers get priority and a higher subsidy.
The machine and dealer must be on your state's approved list.
Most states allow subsidy on the same type of machine only once in several years.

verify: Your state decides the machine list, ceilings and when its portal opens. Many states run application windows, so check your state agriculture engineering/mechanization department.
Your category (SC/ST/General), farmer type (small/marginal/other) and gender must be entered correctly. A mismatch can cancel your application at physical verification.

benefit_tiers.text: You qualify for the higher 50% subsidy rate (SC/ST, women or small/marginal farmers).
The standard subsidy rate of 40% applies to your category.

documents.name: Caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC)
documents.note: Only if claiming the category benefit.

documents.name: Quotation or invoice from an approved dealer

steps: Register on your state's agricultural machinery DBT portal (selecting the correct district, block and village).
Choose the machine from the approved list and apply when your state's window is open.
Wait for sanction before buying. Then buy from an approved dealer and upload the invoice.
After physical verification, the subsidy is credited to your bank account.

online.label: Agricultural Mechanization DBT portal (your state's version)

offline: District / block Agriculture Engineering or Agriculture office
Common Service Centre (CSC) for help with registration

deadline.text: Dates are set by each state; many open a registration window once or twice a year while funds last. Check your state portal.

caveats: Subsidy is capped per machine type, so the actual rupee amount depends on the machine you choose.
